title: PRP 2024 Presidential Pre-Election State Polls
source: RealClearPolling / RealClearPolitics poll records supplied by the user
notes: The uploaded text did not retain candidate column headers. Candidate percentages are aligned using each record's reported spread (Trump+X, Harris+X, or Tie); the two raw values are also preserved as raw_first and raw_second.
State averages on the map are PRP calculations, not official RealClearPolitics averages.
The first unlabeled section was identified as New Mexico from the Albuquerque Journal and The Hill/Emerson records.
Only states represented in the supplied file contain poll records; gray states mean no records were supplied for that state, not that no polling existed.
